card.name: Inside the word nano
card.fires_on: The pieces of words starting with nano (Nano, nan, ano, nanos) in science and technology text, such as nanotechnology, nanosecond, Nano Letters or nanoparticles.

modes.label: Split nano words
modes.description: The word nano is broken into pieces and the marked piece is the start or middle of it.
modes.example: BioFlow, a handheld biological threat detection system under development at The Mitre Corporation's Bio-N<<ano>> Laboratory could one day help emergency response teams

modes.label: Nano as a journal name
modes.description: The word Nano begins a journal title right after a citation.
modes.example: An Optofluidic Nanoplasmonic Biosensor for Direct Detection of Live Viruses from Biological Media.<< Nano>> Letters, 2010;

modes.label: Nano compounds
modes.description: Nano attached to another term, such as particles or second.
modes.example: the disinfecting properties of silver<< nano>>-particles, increasingly used in consumer goods
